description: POC: UI screenshot diagnosis — identify the clipped button in a Crucible-like dashboard mock. Measures element identification, NOT exact phrasing. Pass if the model names the RUN BENCHMARK element (in any reasonable casing).

image_fixture.license: Crucible-owned synthetic UI mock; rendered by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py
image_fixture.notes: Mock dashboard with a 'RUN BENCHMARK >>' button visibly overflowing the Active Arena card boundary into the Provider Bay panel. Generator version 2026-05-25.v1.

questions.question: Look at this UI screenshot. Which UI element is most-clipped or overflowing its container? Name the element.

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for vision_ui_diagnosis. Test uses text_match (ANY-of) so 'RUN BENCHMARK' / 'Run Benchmark' / 'run benchmark' all pass; the case-insensitive contains check makes the test about element identification, not exact casing.

known_scoring_limitations: Currently a one-element diagnosis. A model that says 'the primary action button' without the name fails today — operator can widen pass_phrases or move to a rubric judge later.
Naming any other clipped UI element on the canvas would be a false fail; the canvas was designed with exactly one clipped element.
